text: In two thousand six, scientists trapped a few crows for a study.
One of them wore a caveman mask.
For the next seventeen years, anyone in that mask got screamed at and dive-bombed on sight.
Crows that were never trapped joined in.
They learned the hate by watching.
Then they taught it to their babies.
The scientists tested a second mask to compare.
The crows were completely fine with Dick Cheney.
The feud only ended in twenty twenty-three, after the last crow from two thousand six died.
So if a crow is staring at you right now...
what did you do in two thousand six?
